results.question: 特約永和中正在這禮拜的銷售總額是多少？
results.sql: SELECT SUM(pos_sale.total_amount) AS gross_sales FROM public.pos_sale LEFT JOIN public.store ON pos_sale.store_id = store.store_id WHERE store.store_name = %(f_0)s AND pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL AND (pos_sale.sale_date >= %(p1_start_1)s AND pos_sale.sale_date < %(p1_end_2)s)

filters: store.store_name eq 特約永和中正

results.interpretation: metric gross_sales over pos_sale; for 2026-02-02; where store.store_name eq 特約永和中正
assumptions: pos_sale rows are joined to store through pos_sale.store_id; rows without a matching store row keep NULL there.

gross_sales = Sum of pos_sale.total_amount over sales that are not returns (origin_transaction_no is null): gross sales, the denominator of return ratios by retail convention. Signed by the owner on 2026-09-10. Per product or per category sales are line_sales over pos_saleitem, not this metric.
Relative period resolved from as_of 2026-02-04T18:00:00+08:00: 2026-02-02 is [2026-02-02T00:00:00+08:00, 2026-02-09T00:00:00+08:00) in Asia/Taipei on pos_sale.sale_date.
Measures follow reviewed definitions; the extra filters taken from the question are checked for structure only.

results.question: 中華電信舊號續約SIM卡在1月銷售總額是多少？
results.sql: SELECT SUM(pos_saleitem.amount) AS total_sales FROM public.pos_saleitem LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_saleitem.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no LEFT JOIN public.product ON pos_saleitem.product_id = product.product_id WHERE product.product_name = %(f_0)s AND pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL AND (pos_sale.sale_date >= %(p1_start_1)s AND pos_sale.sale_date < %(p1_end_2)s)

filters: product.product_name eq 中華電信舊號續約SIM卡

results.interpretation: metric line_sales over pos_saleitem; for 2026-01; where product.product_name eq 中華電信舊號續約SIM卡
assumptions: pos_saleitem rows are joined to pos_sale through pos_saleitem.transaction_no; rows without a matching pos_sale row keep NULL there.
pos_saleitem rows are joined to product through pos_saleitem.product_id; rows without a matching product row keep NULL there.

total_sales = Sum of pos_saleitem.amount over line items whose sale is not a return (pos_sale.origin_transaction_no is null): sales at product or category grain, the counterpart of gross_sales for questions grouped by product or category. The sum is the net of every line: trade-ins, revenue adjustments and commissions are booked as negative amounts, so a category made of them shows a negative total (and a negative share) and the other categories' shares are measured against the net. Signed by the owner on 2026-09-10; the net reading confirmed by the owner the same day.
Measures follow reviewed definitions; the extra filters taken from the question are checked for structure only.
